description: Diary entries the digital twin answers from. Edit these to make the twin yours.

entries.text: Had scrambled eggs and toast for breakfast before work.
Lunch was jollof rice and chicken with Tolu at the office canteen.
Finished the Streamlit chapter of the AI course. Session state finally makes sense.
Went for a 5km run around the estate. Felt great, finished in 31 minutes.
Watched two episodes of a Nollywood series with my sister.
Morning standup ran long. Need to prepare the deployment demo by Friday.
Finished reading chapter 4 of Things Fall Apart by Chinua Achebe.
Tried a new amala spot near the office. The ewedu was excellent.
Deployed my first Streamlit app to Streamlit Community Cloud. It worked on the second try after fixing requirements.txt.
Presented the Digital Twin demo to the team. They loved the chat interface.
Went to the market and bought tomatoes, peppers and plantain. Spent 8,500 naira.
Called Mum. She reminded me about cousin Bisi's wedding next month.
